activity.notes: George III had reigned over Great Britain and Ireland since 1760, but the requested United Kingdom polity did not exist until the Acts of Union took effect on 1 January 1801, creating the United Kingdom of Great Britain and Ireland. ATLAS therefore begins this United Kingdom Activity on 1 January 1801 and ends it with George III's death on 29 January 1820. His pre-1801 Great Britain/Ireland and Hanoverian titles are not folded into this Activity.

sources.title: An Act for the Union of Great Britain and Ireland — UK Parliament
sources.citation_text: UK Parliament states that the Union took effect on 1 January 1801 and created the United Kingdom of Great Britain and Ireland.

sources.title: George III (r. 1760-1820) — The Royal Family
sources.citation_text: The Royal Family records George III's reign and his death at Windsor Castle on 29 January 1820.
